title: Detailed pencil
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- pencil body, drawn diagonally -->
  <!-- eraser -->
  <rect x="14" y="76" width="10" height="14" rx="2" transform="rotate(-45 19 83)" fill="#ff8fb1"/>
  <rect x="18" y="72" width="12" height="3" transform="rotate(-45 24 73.5)" fill="#d9dbe8"/>
  <!-- barrel -->
  <polygon points="26,70 30,74 70,34 66,30" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <polygon points="30,74 74,74 70,30 70,34" fill="#f0a91f"/>
  <polygon points="30,74 74,74 70,34 66,30" fill="#e8941000"/>
  <polygon points="30,74 34,74 70,38 66,34" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <polygon points="26,70 30,74 70,34 66,30" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <polygon points="30,74 74,74 70,34 66,30" fill="#ffb62e"/>
  <polygon points="34,74 74,74 70,38 34,74" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <polygon points="30,74 34,74 70,38 66,34" fill="#fff0b0" opacity="0.85"/>
  <!-- wood cone -->
  <polygon points="70,30 74,74 84,64" fill="#f7d9a0"/>
  <polygon points="74,74 84,64 78,58" fill="#e8bb75"/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points="78,58 84,64 88,60" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <polygon points="84,64 88,60 84,56" fill="#8f7ff0"/>
  <polygon points="78,58 88,60 84,56" fill="#4b3fb0"/>
  <!-- ferrule detail -->
  <line x1="24" y1="72" x2="28" y2="68" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="26" y1="74" x2="30" y2="70" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
